profile.headline: Software Engineer at Profound
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Software Engineer Internship
positions.description: Member of research and development team. Develop class based scalable code for existing web applications and machine control services. Enhance web applications with latest web programming technologies. Debug and test code for production. Design database schema to store customer and transaction data.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Computational Geometry research funded and supported by the National Science Foundation. Prove angle bounds of quadrilateral meshes to improve image qualities of computer generated images. Develop, test, analyze, and debug code. Participate, and lead collaborative research with peers, professors, newer participants, and students.

positions.title: OIT Computing Services Stuent Worker
positions.description: Assist faculty and staff with University accounts. Assist students, faculty, and staff transition from TCNJ to Rutgers' systems. Provide computer lab assistance. Troubleshoot classroom and computer calls. Maintain help desk ticketing system.

positions.title: IT Support Analyst
positions.description: Install and perform repairs to hardware, software, and peripheral equipment. Oversee daily performance and security of computer systems. Monitor intrusion detection systems. Contribute to IT audits leading to highest obtainable scores by third parties and Government entities. Develop and test strategies for social engineering. Provisioning of AD and network access.

volunteerExperiences.description: Pack lunches for children that receive free lunch during the school year, but do not receive any assistance during the summer break.
